name: Gradient Table operations and subsystems
description: Test vectors for gradient table operations (spec section 11). Covers passive learning (11.2), backpressure encoding (11.4), table operations (LRU eviction, expiration, wrap detection), and path selection. Entry ranking is covered separately in gradient_entry.json.

passive_learning.name: learn_from_forwarded_packet
passive_learning.description: Forwarding a packet creates a DATA gradient toward the packet source via the sender neighbor (spec 11.2)

passive_learning.name: passive_cannot_replace_explicit
passive_learning.description: DATA-learned gradient cannot replace an existing ANNOUNCE gradient (lower priority)

passive_learning.name: passive_replaces_expired_explicit
passive_learning.description: DATA gradient replaces an expired ANNOUNCE gradient (existing has expired)

passive_learning.name: passive_updates_better_data
passive_learning.description: Fresher DATA gradient replaces older DATA gradient (same priority, compare seq_num)

congestion_encoding.name: decode_congestion_from_app_data
congestion_encoding.description: Decode congestion from app_data with multiple TLVs
congestion_encoding.notes: Coords TLV (type=0x01, lat=476062000, lon=-1223321000), then congestion TLV (type=0x02, Q=42)

congestion_encoding.name: decode_congestion_missing
congestion_encoding.description: No congestion TLV in app_data returns null
congestion_encoding.notes: Only coords TLV present (Seattle), no congestion indicator

table_operations.name: lru_eviction_order
table_operations.description: When table exceeds max_entries, least-recently-used entries are evicted first
table_operations.notes: fe80::2 evicted because lookup of fe80::1 made it MRU

table_operations.name: expire_old_entries
table_operations.description: expire_old removes entries whose expires <= now

table_operations.name: lookup_returns_none_for_expired
table_operations.description: lookup returns None for expired entry even if present in table

table_operations.name: remove_via_next_hop
table_operations.description: remove_via removes all entries routing through a specific next_hop

wrap_detection.name: wrap_detected_high_to_low
wrap_detection.description: Seq wrap detected: existing >49152, new <16384, entry aged >50% TTL
wrap_detection.notes: Entry created at 1000000ms (expires=1600000, TTL=600000). At now=1350000, age=350000 > 300000 (50% of TTL). Existing seq=65000 > 49152, new seq=100 < 16384. Wrap detected.

wrap_detection.name: wrap_not_detected_too_young
wrap_detection.description: No wrap detection if entry has not aged past 50% TTL
wrap_detection.notes: At now=1100000, age=100000 < 300000 (50% of TTL=600000). Wrap heuristic not triggered. RFC 1982 comparison: 100 vs 65000 gives diff=(65000-100)&0xFFFF=64900 >= 32768, so 100 is NOT fresher. New entry loses.

wrap_detection.name: wrap_not_detected_seq_in_middle
wrap_detection.description: No wrap detection if existing seq not in high range (>49152)
wrap_detection.notes: existing seq=40000 is NOT > 49152, so wrap heuristic not triggered. RFC 1982: 100 vs 40000 gives diff=(40000-100)&0xFFFF=39900 >= 32768, so 100 is NOT fresher.

path_selection.name: select_least_congested
path_selection.description: When multiple next-hops have equal hop count, select least congested (spec 11.4)

path_selection.name: hop_count_beats_congestion
path_selection.description: Fewer hops wins even if more congested (hop_count has priority)
path_selection.notes: hop_count is compared first per spec 11.3; congestion only breaks ties

path_selection.name: no_congestion_data_available
path_selection.description: When congestion data is missing (null), treat as 0
path_selection.notes: null queue_depth treated as 0 (no congestion info = assume not congested)

timeouts.name: announce_timeout
timeouts.description: ANNOUNCE/RREP gradients use GRADIENT_TIMEOUT_MS (600 sec = 10 min)

timeouts.name: data_timeout
timeouts.description: DATA (passive learning) gradients use DATA_GRADIENT_TIMEOUT_MS (60 sec)
